name: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (Canonical Space + Deformation Field)
definition: A dynamic reconstruction method that uses an MLP to implicitly fit a deformation field. It inputs positional-encoded Gaussian position and timestep t to the MLP, which outputs offsets for position, rotation, and scaling.
summary: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs dynamic scenes by mapping static canonical Gaussians to observation space via an implicit deformation field, distinguishing itself by learning continuous motion rather than storing explicit trajectories.
